context.body: The narrative places seven years for the Temple beside thirteen for the palace complex.

observations.body: Solomon spends thirteen years on royal buildings, including the Forest of Lebanon, judgment hall, residence, and a house for Pharaoh’s daughter.

observations.body: Royal life receives a larger and longer construction program than the Temple.
